auth.register.description: Gadzira yakachengeteka passkey wallet nemudziyo wako. Hapana ruzivo rwe crypto runodiwa.
auth.register.securityNote: Chikwama chako chinochengetedzwa nebiometric yemudziyo wako. Hapana makiyi akavanzika anosiya mudziyo wako.
auth.sign.title: Gadzira account yako
auth.login.signInDescription: Shandisa password yako kuti uwane zvakachengetedzeka account yako.
auth.login.noPasskey: Hapana kiyi yekupfuura yawanikwa pamudziyo uyu.
landing.heroDesc: Decentralized savings madenderedzwa paStellar. Zero intermediaries. Kutonga kwemari kune 1.3 bhiriyoni isina kubhengi.
landing.feat1Desc: Smart zvibvumirano zvinosimbisa mutemo wese. Hapana murongi anogona kumhanya nedziva. Yese yakapihwa inosimbiswa pa-chetani.
landing.feat2Desc: Chero munhu ane chikwama cheStellar. Hapana akaundi yekubhangi. Hapana cheki chechikwereti. Hapana miganhu.
landing.feat3Desc: Vaka yako MoiScore neyese-nguva mupiro. Portable financial identity.
landing.feat4Desc: Stellar sub-cent transactions inoita kuti denderedzwa rezuva nezuva riite. Hapana mari yepuratifomu yekugadzira kana kujoinha.
landing.feat5Desc: Random, fixed, auction, kana kuvhota. Denderedzwa rako, mitemo yako.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC nhasi. Mamwe ma stablecoins pamugwagwa.
landing.readyDesc: Gadzira denderedzwa rako rekutanga rekuchengetedza mukati memaminitsi maviri.
